execution.ref: scripts/dev/miner_launchpad/setup_operations.py, environment_setup.py, controller.py, app.js; carbon/miner_mcp/mcp_setup.py, open_tier.attach_operations, standard_cli --state-dir; tests/cpu/test_miner_setup_agent_first.py
execution.description: OWNER-MINER-SETUP-AGENT-FIRST-01: miner setup made agent first. One setup table generates the browser routes and the MCP tools over one set of records; a status call returns the next step, what it lacks and the exact next call; the signer and the registration answer human_action_required; a model key reaches the MCP door only as an owner-only file; the tools appear tier by tier in one session, up to launch.

expected: The operations-table pattern (operations.py driving the browser routes and the MCP tools) carries over to setup unchanged.
observed: It did, with three additions the pattern had not needed. Two doors now write the same setup records from two processes, so the record's read-modify-write takes a file lock beside the thread lock. Tools must appear mid-session at two tier boundaries (registration, then the written profile), so a door object grows the live server with the same strictness check attach_campaign uses. And the browser could not show an agent's progress without re-reading setup, so the page polls it and rebuilds only on a change, never under a person's cursor. The order change exposed a dependency: Hermes' ready-made profile is written with setup's model, so Hermes keeps Inference and its files move to Review when it is chosen first; only an agent that brings its own model skips it.
keep: Generate every door from one table and one perform; let a parity test compare the generated schemas, the refusals and the records across doors.
Give an agent one status call with closed codes and the exact next call, and make the miner's own steps a closed human_action_required result rather than a refusal.
Read client configuration from each client's current documentation, cite it with its date, and mark everything not run UNVERIFIED instead of inventing a flag.
change: When two processes share a record file, add the file lock with the second door, not after a race.
Check a step's dependencies on later steps before reordering a wizard.
